in_hebrew.name: Mair
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bright or radiant
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mair הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Welsh word ‘mawr’, meaning ‘great’ or ‘large’. The name Mair is often translated as ‘bright’, ‘shining’, or ‘radiant’. In Welsh folklore, Mair was also the name of a fairy queen.

in_greek.name: Mair
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bright or radiant
in_greek.long_meaning: Mair είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Welsh word ‘mawr’, meaning ‘great’ or ‘large’. The name Mair is often translated as ‘bright’, ‘shining’, or ‘radiant’. In Welsh folklore, Mair was also the name of a fairy queen.

in_latin.name: Mair
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bright or radiant
in_latin.long_meaning: Mair est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Welsh word ‘mawr’, meaning ‘great’ or ‘large’. The name Mair is often translated as ‘bright’, ‘shining’, or ‘radiant’. In Welsh folklore, Mair was also the name of a fairy queen.
